run.question: In Loki, run the query `{service="checkout"}` against namespace app-282 and tell me how many error-level log lines come back. If the selector returns nothing, find the right one.

report.summary: The literal selector {service="checkout"} in namespace app-282 returned no lines (no_data, not citable as fact). The working selector is {namespace="app-282", acme_service="checkout"}, whose stream labels also carry job="checkout-logs", filename="/var/log/checkout.log", pod="checkout-698c8f5df-dwqgn" and a level label. Against that selector in the authorized 24h window (2026-11-20T05:26:29Z to 2026-11-21T05:26:29Z), there are 4 error-level log lines: count_over_time with | json | level="ERROR" returns 4, an independent text filter |= "ERROR" also returns 4, and the level breakdown is ERROR 4, WARN 2, INFO 10 (16 lines total). The four ERROR lines observed are: "Payment processor refused: invalid token (txn 9d1f)", "Inventory check timed out for SKU-77481", "Order persistence failed: deadlock on orders table", and "Webhook delivery exhausted retries for partner ACME". All lines returned fall inside a single burst around 2026-11-21T05:25:55.427652Z-05:25:55.428483Z, and the whole-window count is only 16 lines, so the sample is very small. No fault attribution or root cause is asserted: this is a log-count question, and the ERROR messages are reported as observations only.

claims.text: The literal query {service="checkout"} matched nothing; the checkout logs in namespace app-282 are labelled acme_service="checkout" along with job="checkout-logs", filename="/var/log/checkout.log", pod="checkout-698c8f5df-dwqgn" and a level label (values observed: INFO, WARN, ERROR), not service="checkout".
For {namespace="app-282", acme_service="checkout"} over the whole authorized window (24h range selector), sum(count_over_time(... | json | level="ERROR" [24h])) = 4 error-level lines.

The level breakdown of that same stream over the whole window is ERROR 4, INFO 10, WARN 2 — 16 log lines in total, so the 4 ERROR lines are the complete error count in this window for this selector, not a truncation of a larger set.
An independent count using a raw text filter, sum(count_over_time({namespace="app-282", acme_service="checkout"} |= "ERROR" [24h])), also returns 4, agreeing with the parsed-level count.

The ERROR lines present in the returned sample are exactly: "Payment processor refused: invalid token (txn 9d1f)", "Inventory check timed out for SKU-77481", "Order persistence failed: deadlock on orders table", and "Webhook delivery exhausted retries for partner ACME"; the same sample also shows 2 WARN lines ("Slow database response from orders_db (1.2s)", "Rate limiter near threshold for /v1/checkout") and 10 INFO "Checkout flow completed for cart N" lines.

All log lines returned for this selector fall inside a single burst at 2026-11-21T05:25:55.427652Z through 2026-11-21T05:25:55.428483Z (source_start_at to source_end_at of the stream query), and the whole-window metric count is 16 lines, so the observed log volume is extremely small and concentrated at one instant.

The four ERROR messages describe failures against dependencies (payment processor invalid token, inventory timeout, orders-table deadlock, webhook retry exhaustion), which would suggest checkout-side problems in payment, inventory, orders persistence and webhook delivery, but this Run collected only log counts and no per-dependency traces, error spans or metrics, so none of these is established as a fault or as related to a single cause.

If the error lines are to be attributed, add a corroborating query set: traces of checkout for the same window, error-status span counts per operation, and the corresponding dependency services (payment, inventory/orders, webhook partner) logged signals — this Run did not collect them.

gaps: The exact requested selector {service="checkout"} against namespace app-282 returned nothing (query status no_data, 0 lines, not citable as fact); the values returned show the checkout log stream is labelled acme_service="checkout" plus namespace="app-282", and no service label value was seen in this stream.

The count of 4 rests on a 24h window whose entire log volume is 16 lines in one burst at 2026-11-21T05:25:55Z; log volume before or outside that burst cannot be characterized beyond the fact that the metric count over the window totals 16 lines, and Loki retention/ingest gaps could hide lines that were never queried (queries were limited to the newest 20 lines for the stream view).
No pod status, restart counts, events or traces were inspected in this Run, so whether the 4 ERROR lines correspond to an incident, to a restart, or to steady-state background errors is unknown.
Change-history integration is not available in this Run, so no change correlation could be checked.
next_steps: Re-run the count with pod-level labels (pod="checkout-698c8f5df-dwqgn") or a longer/earlier window to confirm the 4-error figure holds outside the single observed burst.
